rules.intent: A mock must not scroll or clip horizontally at any declared viewport — no page-level or entry-level overflow past the viewport's clientWidth.
rules.rationale: Adaptation is a rendered property, not an authored one; a mock that only works at its narrowest viewport is exactly the escape the static atlas checks cannot see.

rules.intent: At wide viewports a mock's content must use the screen — no phone-width column centred on a desktop unless the root declares data-narrow.
rules.rationale: Adaptation is a rendered property, not an authored one; a phone-width column centred on a desktop cell is exactly the escape the static atlas checks cannot see.

rules.intent: Body copy at wide viewports should sit within a comfortable measure — no unbounded line lengths in wide-viewport text blocks.
rules.rationale: A very long measure hurts readability at wide viewports; warn-only until a host observes its false-positive rate in practice.
